name: Bhausaheb Fundkar Orchard Plantation Scheme
required_documents: Consent letter from all co-owners (if joint landholding)
Copy of first page of Aadhaar-linked bank passbook with photo
benefits: 100% financial subsidy for orchard plantation disbursed across 3 years (50% in Year 1, 30% in Year 2, 20% in Year 3)
100% subsidy for installation of drip irrigation system
Subsidized or directly permitted supply of recommended saplings/grafts from government, agricultural university, or accredited private nurseries
flagged_conditions: First priority given to families whose sole source of livelihood is agriculture (husband, wife, minor children).
Priority given to SC/ST farmers, small/marginal farmers, women, and persons with disabilities (Divyang).
30% of the target budget is reserved for women farmers across all categories.
Plantation survival requirement: At least 80% survival rate required in Year 1 and 90% in Year 2 to receive subsequent year installments.
Farmers eligible under MGNREGA must first exhaust MGNREGA benefits up to 2 hectares before availing this scheme for remaining land.
Area previously benefited under state orchard schemes will be deducted from maximum eligible land limit.
Drip irrigation system must be maintained in the same field for at least 7 years.
Soil testing is mandatory at farmer's expense for citrus fruit crops (Lime, Orange, Sweet Lime).
Plantation work must be completed within 75 days from date of receiving prior approval (पूर्वसंमती).
Application must be submitted within 21 days from the date of advertisement publication.
